'''Drop Canyon''' was a small farming village on [[Ceriun]], a primitive agrarian [[Planet/Legends|world]].

==History==
When a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] crash-landed near the settlement, Drop Canyon became the setting for a violent confrontation between the elders and youth of the village over the possession of a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]]. When the elders met to debate the matter, a group of armed youths from the village appeared to claim the holocron for the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. A brawl subsequently broke out, in which several of the adults were killed. The fight was interrupted by the appearance of a [[Unidentified tattooed Sith|tattooed Sith]], who seized the holocron, and then killed several of the youths as a "reward" for their "help".

The Sith Lord left the youth's ring-leader, [[Tenno]], to the mercy of the village, but commanded the villagers not to touch him after he left.
